notes: Rugby is teams scoring on a marked field, so Sports leads and the space is space-bounded: touchlines and in-goal areas as a rigid perimeter, tries registering over the goal line, a centre restart, and painted halfway and 22-metre lines. Field Sport is the preset, with the arena wall added from the stylised-arena answer. Simulation is named second only for the stated speed, strength, agility and stamina upgrades — that is a purchase storefront, so it lands on Simulation's upgrades-bazaar wording of social-hub; I did not let it lead, because the match is the game rather than the number, and there is no walled tier ladder here, which is what keeps this on P0 instead of importing Stat Grinder. Decided without a user: half-length, half-width pitch per the answers, the upgrade counters sited just outside the touchline so they are reachable between matches instead of on the field, and no seating or interiors since none was asked for; tackle physics, running physics and timed halves are gameplay and carry no layout.
